messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary healthcheck FAILED for service `prompt-router` (canary=5%). Error rate 4.8% 500s over 10m. image=registry.redwood/team/prompt-router@sha256:abcd1234
incident-bot: Incident opened ID INC-2026-042: canary-failure-prompt-router (severity=P2) - paging oncall
alex: oncall here, seeing the page. linking logs and canary dashboard now. @mari can you grab build info?
mari: looking. CI shows pipeline #7842 -> artifact sha256:abcd1234 produced at 2026-03-15T09:40:12Z. No flaky tests reported but we have a layered cache step that wrote a "layer-override" artifact. digging into build logs.
jordan: svc owners reporting elevated 5xxs on /generate and increased latency. Canary instances are throwing a kernel-level error in the inference runtime: "kv_cache_load: checksum mismatch" in logs.
alex: first priority: stop further rollout and protect customers. putting feature flag `rt-prompt-router-v2` to off now via FF console.
alex: command run: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $FF_API' https://ff.redwood/api/flags/rt-prompt-router-v2/off` -> 200 OK. Notifying deploy system to halt promotion.
oncall-runbook-bot: Runbook step: if canary 5% failing, 1) pause rollout, 2) flip feature flag, 3) rollback to previous stable image, 4) open postmortem.
alex: pausing rollout via deploy-bot: `/deploy pause rollout prompt-router` -> acknowledged. Deploy queue halted.
deploy-bot: Rollout paused for `prompt-router`. Current canary replicas pinned 5%.
mari: found suspicious step in CI cache: `layer-merge` job pulled mutable cache from mirror S3 path `s3://ci-cache/prompt-router/latest` which had a partial rewrite during concurrent job. The merged tar contained a mismatched layer header. pushing to registry succeeded (no checksum validation on push).
katie: we should revoke the bad image tag and mark it as untrusted in registry. I'll coordinate with registry-admin.
jordan: for mitigation, can we force traffic to previous image without full cluster redeploy? we can promote `sha256:9f8e7c6d` (previous stable) to the tag and let routing switch.
alex: initiating quick rollback: `deploy-bot promote-image prompt-router stable sha256:9f8e7c6d` -> started. Also triggering autoscale to shift canary traffic down.
deploy-bot: Promotion started. New image promotion may take ~45s to propagate to nodes; kube-level pulls will begin.
mari: I ran local checksum compare between bad layer and expected: `sha256:abcd1234` != expected `sha256:expectedlayer` -> confirmed corruption. saving offending artifact to s3://incidents/INC-2026-042/artifacts/ for forensic.
incident-bot: Updating incident INC-2026-042 with mitigation step: feature flag off, rollout paused, rollback promoted. Severity remains P2 until customer impact verified.
katie: registry-admin confirmed tag untagged from registry UI and set as quarantine. Access logs show 37 pulls of the bad sha, mostly in canary cluster and three in eu-west prod at 09:44Z. Customer impact window ~09:40-09:47 UTC.
alex: monitoring to confirm error rates drop. if rates don't recover in 5m, we'll initiate full rollback and send customer comms.
(just now) grafana: error rate on prompt-router back under baseline <0.1% after promotion.
alex: looks like rollback worked. moving to handoff: @mari please lead the postmortem, include CI cache rewrite race, lack of image push checksum validation, and mitigation steps (FF kill-switch instrumentation, registry quarantine automation, CI cache immutability).
mari: will do. suggested immediate actions: 1) add digest verification to publish pipeline, 2) enforce immutable cache keys or transactional write with lease, 3) add deploy gating rule to detect kernel-level runtime checksum errors and auto-pause.
jordan: I'll draft customer impact notes for SRE-runbook and support. we saw 12 customer-facing errors by error-id; few retried automatically.
alex: handoff to oncall follow-up: I'm marking this resolved-for-now, but leave incident open for postmortem. final status: canary paused, feature flag off, bad image quarantined, previous image promoted.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-042 status: mitigation complete, investigation in progress. Assigning to mari for P1 follow-up and postmortem deadline 2026-03-19.
mari: acknowledged, will own postmortem. adding next steps and linking pipeline logs: https://ci.redwood/pipelines/7842/logs
alex: thanks all. tagging this thread for postmortem collection and timeline writeup. :white_check_mark:
